semantics.chain_rule: Audit records may link explicit predecessor/segment identities.
semantics.hash_rule: Integrity hash/profile is explicit where used.
semantics.order_rule: Canonical evidence order derives from explicit chain/sequence semantics, not timestamps alone.
semantics.append_rule: Audit history is append-only under the active audit profile.
semantics.gap_rule: Detected chain gaps/corruption remain explicit findings.
semantics.authority_rule: Valid chain proves evidence integrity only, not action legitimacy.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.
